title: Mitosis core rebuild: complete the SPEC implementation

completion_criteria.text: Preconditions 0-5 of 0116's landing order are each proven discharged by measurement, or their residual named and landed, or deferred by a recorded decision. None is assumed discharged.
MSP-1..MSP-13 of the core-rebuild SPEC are each shipped and merged to main, or retired by a recorded decision naming the reason. MSP-0 shipped as PR #15 (12053dc) and is not re-done.
The declared phase set is exactly the collapsed eight (Probe, Decompose, Prep, Execute, Integrate, Ship, Resume, Remediate) and phase-parity proves declared == calls == opts.phase both ways.
SPEC success 1: a fix-typed spec ships end to end through the collapsed phase set, its receipt observed red on base and green on branch by a deterministic verb, never asserted by a model.
SPEC success 3: every Verified: line on a mitosis-opened PR is composed from a journaled gate manifest entry with a recorded exit code; absent and BROKEN gates render --not-verified with reason.
MSP-1's budget gate holds a baseline for one real current-engine run, and a post-collapse run is measured against section 6's 3-fixed-plus-9-per-MSP budget, making 0115's falsifiers payable.
The SPEC is re-grounded and committed: every citation in sections 4, 5, 12, 14 re-verified against current mitosis.js, stale anchors corrected, and every audit validity gap closed by a decision.

spine.active_goal: Finish the step-6 SPEC (2026-07-30-mitosis-core-rebuild.md). Audit, remedy and re-baseline DONE; it holds 5 of 8 invariants with 8 residual defects. MSP-1..13 BLOCKED per 0133 until Step 3 lands.
spine.next_step: Read handoff-2026-08-03-mitosis-core-rebuild/HANDOFF.md FIRST. Run ONE round closing the 8 residual defects, chiefly adding decisions 0130 and 0210. Do NOT re-run the audit or anchor derivation.

open_risks.text: Enumerate every in-band decision record and mark it bearing or non-bearing — 0130 and 0210 sat inside the searched band and were still missed, a recall failure within declared scope.
Load 0210 before running any test — it defines green as npm test with zero failures other than protect-claude-config.test.mjs, plus phase-parity and mirror-guard passing.
Treat step 1.5 as new construction, not a flag flip — PR #30 deleted runScheduleStreaming and STREAMING_DISPATCH_ENABLED, so nothing survives to flip.
Land step 3 before MSP-1 — run-log.mjs records no dispatch boundary, wall-clock or prompt-hash, so 0115's falsifiers stay unpayable and 0133 blocks MSP-1.
Recover the steps 4 and 5 verdicts from workflow-output/audit-run.json — they were audited but omitted from the consolidated table, and criterion c1 spans steps 0-5.
Re-measure the worktree leak count before dispositioning step 0 — 0195 records 13 found, 9 removed and 4 held, while the docket states 12 to 6.
Re-derive the twin set per MSP from MIRROR_CENSUS — it is now 39 modules with 28 needing byte-identical double edits, up from 0126's 21.
Read artifacts from the handoff dir, never the scratchpad — scratchpad copies are ephemeral and the SPEC's only committed copy is d444797, unamended.
Plan for interactive approval on writes under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} — the guard is live and every MSP writes there, so unattended fan-out stalls.
Stage explicit paths only, never git add -A — five pre-existing dirty paths must stay uncommitted, including .claude/settings.json and .zshrc.
Rephrase PR prose that names merge tooling — pr-create blocks a body value carrying a literal merge command, since the gate cannot tell describing from running.
Never read the .bak snapshot as the current engine — it carries the pre-MSP-0 phase set (Final review, Shepherd), is inert, and is older than main.

key_decisions.title: The seven completion criteria are compressed to fit the 200-char cap, meaning preserved, none struck
The re-baseline pass amends the SPEC document only; no live codebase change
Repair rounds are gated on a fixed invariant set, and stop at NOT READY rather than declare a false green

out_of_scope: The feat pipeline - 0110 and 0118 sequence it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary. Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118 (limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary).
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for fix specifically. An off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - 0108. A webhook, daemon or server for the relaunch trigger - 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116 and 0120. Edges stay LSP-grounded; in-engine overlap survives as a pruning input only, never as the oracle.

Cluster-aware scheduling, and the journal's 2000-character paging through model output - fenced out by SPEC section 1 and deferred in section 13. Adding any new phase, work type or scheduler - section 1 forbids it.

Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117. Mitosis deploys its own gates and authors one receipt inside an EXISTING runner; an unmet floor halts fail-closed and names verify-setup.
Re-doing MSP-0. It shipped as PR #15 (12053dc): Final review deleted, Shepherd renamed to Resume, phase-parity gate live. Verify it still holds; do not re-implement it.

Other specs are consulted ONLY as evidence for the steps 0-5 precondition audit. Implementing their unshipped work is out of scope: run-readiness-repair MSP-0..MSP-10, the two-track invariant plan, b6-harness-liveness, quiescent-advance M0-M8 (already delivered).
The predecessor thread's two open follow-ups belong to it, not here: hardening .claude/hooks/block-destructive-bash.sh, and the settings deny drift per decision 0227.
